verdict.rationale: Each Jules task runs in its own isolated cloud VM (jules-docs-3), and usage-limit tiers explicitly target 'power users & agent-heavy workflows' with task quotas up to 300 (jules-docs-13/17/18), while the API enables programmatic dispatch of many tasks/custom workflows (jules-docs-9/15). Community reports corroborate running many tasks concurrently ('handles large quantities of tasks very well', accumulating multiple PRs to review after a day) (jules-comm-11, jules-comm-12, jules-comm-16). Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a hard concurrency limit or dashboard for managing simultaneous sessions, and more independent/enterprise-scale case studies beyond individual/side-project usage.
